name: Lemegeton
detailed_description:
Welcome to the world of [Lemegeton].

Become Logan, an ill-fated hero branded with a demonic stigma, and explore the despair-ridden Nebraknok Island. Once a peaceful land, it is now a hunting ground for unleashed demons and a profane altar for rituals seeking to resurrect a great demon. You must embark on this hellish journey to follow the traces of your brother, Kyle, who was also branded for unknown reasons and sacrificed himself to save you. Is he still alive? Or has he already become something irreversible? Every choice you make will determine your fate.

Key Features:

  • Strategic Exploration and Growth: Freely explore the vast yet perilous Nebraknok Island. But be warned: time is limited, and the demons grow ever stronger. Plan your optimal routes in an ever-changing environment, survive demonic encounters, and cultivate the power you need. Every decision directly impacts your survival.

  • Weighty and Challenging Combat System: Experience deep, stamina-based combat where every attack, dodge, and block is crucial. Create deadly openings by precisely 'parrying' enemy attacks, and turn the tide with powerful counterblows. A diverse host of demons, each with unique attack patterns and cunning abilities, will keep you on edge in every battle.

  • The 'Stigma Gauge' - Where Risk Meets Reward: The demonic stigma etched upon you is an indelible source of agony, yet also of immense power. The 'Stigma Gauge' fills as you actively use demonic powers in combat, acquire certain cursed relics, or are exposed to potent enemy attacks. As the gauge rises, you gain devastating demonic abilities and can engage in secret transactions with 'Demon Merchants,' hidden from human eyes. However, the price is steep: more powerful demonic pursuers will relentlessly hunt you down, and your precious humanity may wane, making interactions with 'Human Merchants' increasingly difficult. You must find the optimal balance in this precarious dance for survival.

  • A Desperate and Moving Journey to Find Your Brother: Your sole hope and objective is to find your missing brother, Kyle. Follow the scattered clues across the island, the faint echoes of his voice carried on the wind through ruins, and the brutal battle scars he left behind in his fight against the demons. But the truth you confront at the end of your path may shatter even hope itself.

  • Ever-Evolving Challenges, Endless Roguelike Depth: Death is not the end, but a new beginning. The island's layout, monster placements, and the myriad combinations of relics and abilities change with each playthrough, offering you endless challenges and opportunities for growth. Learn from failure, perfect your own strategies, and overcome the nightmare that enshrouds Nebraknok Island.

short_description: As a hero branded by demons, fight to save your brother and confront the nightmares consuming Nebraknok Island. In [Lemegeton], an action roguelike where perilous choices and the lure of demonic power test you at every moment, can you preserve your humanity?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 (Version 1909 or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K (4 * 3400) / AMD FX-8350 (4 * 4000)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 960 (2048 MB) / AMD Radeon RX 470 (2048 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A 64-bit processor and operating system are required
